ingredients.text: •1/3 vanilla bean + splash vanilla (bean not necessary, but worth it)
• 1/3 - 2/3 vanilla bean sm splash warmed up vanilla
best refrigerated and then whisked with more cream

instructions.text: •Weigh out flours & salt, amylase combine, set aside
•In a Large bowl, measure out yeast
•In a Smaller saucepan (or microwave bowl), weigh out milk(cream+water) & sugar, combine
•Medium heat, warm milk sugar mixture until 115F (microwave, probably 20 sec? intervals)
•Do not exceed 140F or it will kill yeast
•Pour milk mixture into yeast, whisk
•Let mix sit about 15 minutes
•Melt butter and Crisco together, cool
•Add vanilla, egg, + melted butter & Crisco to milk yeast mix, whisk
•Add flour mix to milk mix, combine (I use silicone spatula)
•On a very lightly floured surface, gently knead/fold dough for 5-7 minutes
•Grease large bowl with Crisco
•Make dough into ball and place into well greased bowl
•Cover and let rise 2-3 hours
•After, either roll out and shape dough or rest in fridge overnight
•Press dough down
•Roll dough out into about 1/8" to 1/4"
•With an uncrustable sandwich cutter (any proper sized circular cutter), cut out donuts
•Cut out center of donut with medicine cup bottom or proper sized equivalent
•Once cut, let rise 30 minutes to 1 hour on a foiled, lightly floured, sheet pan
•Prepare wire racks (and sheet trays to lay under them, foiled/covered)
•Once risen, in a Large pan or wok (I use a wok, on a plug in heating element for less mess) heat Crisco to 350F, no more or donuts will burn
•Fill wok a little less than halfway
•With a candy thermometer, check temperature of Crisco (don't touch bottom of pan)
•As soon as temperature says around 345F and climbing, quickly but carefully place as many donuts as you can fit into the hot Crisco
•Set a 1 minute timer as soon as you put the last donut of the batch in
•Keep and eye on donuts as not to burn
•Flip after 1 minute and cook 1 more minute
•Cook 1 minute on each side
•Donuts will be a light to medium brown/golden
•With a spider strainer, strain out donuts onto wire rack
•Continue process until all dough is fried
•While donuts are still warm, dip in glaze on either side, tapping gently on side of bowl to remove excess
•Place donuts back onto wire racks to let glaze set
•Continue until all donuts are glazed and glaze is set
Enjoy~
